facts.value: Official high school transcripts are required if: (1) You have fewer than 24 transferable semester hours of college credit after high school; (2) You're applying to a program that specifically requires a high school transcript, regardless of your credit hours; (3) You've earned an associate degree (or higher) but with fewer than 24 transferable semester credits post-high school.
facts.programme_association: African and African American Studies - BA

facts.value: Transcripts must reflect all four years of coursework and include your graduation date. They must be sent directly from the high school through a secure electronic service approved by ASU, by mail, or via email directly from a school official. ASU only accepts hand-delivered official high school transcripts if they are in a sealed envelope provided by the school. ASU does not accept faxed high school transcripts.
facts.programme_association: African and African American Studies - BA

facts.value: Order your official GED transcript online to be sent directly to ASU. ASU requires a battery average score of 170 or higher for tests taken after 2013. ASU also accepts the HiSet, TASC (Test Assessing Secondary Completion), California High School Proficiency Examination, and College Credit Pathway, with some limitations.
facts.programme_association: African and African American Studies - BA

facts.value: ACT or SAT scores are not required for admission, but may be used in place of a high school GPA if necessary. Have your scores sent to ASU directly from ACT or College Board.
facts.programme_association: African and African American Studies - BA

facts.value: If you have taken AP, IB or CLEP exams, request your scores be sent directly to ASU.
facts.programme_association: African and African American Studies - BA
